units.source_text: 这一年夏天，天气比往年更加炎热，人人不堪其苦。

en.t: That summer, the weather was hotter than in other years, and everyone found the suffering unbearable.

units.source_text: 薰君料想川上必然凉爽，便立刻动身赴宇治访问。

en.t: Kaoru thought it must be cooler upstream, so he set out at once to visit Uji.

units.source_text: 早晨凉爽的时候从京中启程，但到达宇治时已经赤日当空，阳光眩目。

en.t: He left the capital in the cool of the morning, but by the time he reached Uji the blazing sun was already high overhead, its light dazzling.

units.source_text: 薰君召唤那值宿人出来，叫他打开八亲王生前所居西室，入内休息。

en.t: Kaoru summoned the night attendant and had him open the western room where Prince Hachi had lived, then went in to rest.

units.source_text: 此时两女公子正住在中央正厅的佛堂里，离薰君所居太近，似觉不宜，便准备回自己房间去。

en.t: At the time the two young ladies were staying in the chapel in the central main hall, but feeling it improper to be so close to Kaoru's quarters, they prepared to return to their own rooms.

units.source_text: 她们虽然悄悄地行动，但因相去甚近，这边自然听到声音。

en.t: Although they moved quietly, they were so near that sounds naturally carried to his side.

units.source_text: 薰君情不自禁了。

en.t: Kaoru could no longer restrain himself.

units.source_text: 他曾看到此西室与正厅之间所设纸门的一端，装锁的地方有一小孔，便把遮住纸门的屏风拉开，向孔中窥探。

en.t: He had once noticed a small hole by the lock at one end of the paper door between this western room and the main hall, so he drew aside the screen that covered the door and peered through the hole.

units.source_text: 岂知洞孔的那边立着一架帷屏，把洞孔挡住。

en.t: But on the other side of the hole stood a curtained screen, blocking his view.

units.source_text: 薰君心甚懊丧，想离去了。

en.t: Kaoru was deeply disappointed and thought of leaving.

units.source_text: 正在此时，一阵风来，把朝外的帘子吹起。

en.t: Just then a gust of wind came and blew up the blinds facing outside.

units.source_text: 有一个侍女叫道：“外面望进来都看见了！

en.t: One maid cried out, "Anyone looking in from outside can see everything!

units.source_text: 把帷屏推出去挡住帘子吧。”

en.t: Push the curtained screen out to cover the blinds."

units.source_text: 薰君想道：“这办法好笨啊！”

en.t: Kaoru thought, "What a clumsy solution!"

units.source_text: 心中很高兴，再向孔中窥视，但见高的帷屏、矮的帷屏都已推在佛堂面前的帘子旁边。

en.t: Delighted inwardly, he looked through the hole again and saw that both the tall and short curtained screens had been pushed beside the blinds in front of the chapel.

units.source_text: 和这纸门相对的一边的纸门开着，她们正从开着的纸门里走向那边的房间去。

en.t: The paper door opposite this one was open, and they were walking through it toward the room beyond.

units.source_text: 首先看见一人走出来，从帷屏的垂布隙间向外窥视。

en.t: First he saw one of them come out and look outside through a gap in the hanging cloth of the curtained screen.

units.source_text: ——薰君的随从人等正在佛堂外面闲步纳凉。

en.t: Kaoru's attendants were strolling about outside the chapel, enjoying the cool air.

units.source_text: 她身穿一件深灰色单衫，系着一条萱草色裙子。

en.t: She wore a dark gray unlined robe and had tied on a daylily-colored skirt.

units.source_text: 那深灰色被萱草色一衬托，显得异样美观，反而鲜艳夺目。

en.t: Set off by the daylily color, the dark gray looked strangely beautiful and, by contrast, strikingly vivid.

units.source_text: 这大约是与穿的人的体态有关吧。

en.t: This was probably because of the figure of the person wearing it.

units.source_text: 她肩上随意挂着吊带，手持念珠，隐在衣袖之中。

en.t: A cord hung casually over her shoulder, and she held prayer beads hidden within her sleeve.

units.source_text: 身材苗条，姿态绰约。

en.t: Her figure was slender and her bearing graceful.

units.source_text: 头发长垂，比衣裾略高，发端一丝不乱，光彩浓艳，非常美丽。

en.t: Her hair fell long, stopping just above the hem of her robe; its ends were perfectly neat, lustrous, rich in color, and exceedingly beautiful.

units.source_text: 薰君望见她的侧影，觉得异常可爱。

en.t: Seeing her profile, Kaoru found her extraordinarily lovely.

units.source_text: 他以前曾经隐约窥见明石皇后所生大公主的姿色，此时觉得这女公子的艳丽、温柔、优雅之相，正和大公主相似，心中赞叹不置。

en.t: He had once caught a faint glimpse of the beauty of the eldest princess born to Empress Akashi, and now he felt that this young lady's brilliance, gentleness, and elegance resembled hers, leaving him filled with admiration.

units.source_text: 后来又有一人膝行而出，说道：“那边的纸门外面窥得见呢！”

en.t: Then another came out on her knees and said, "People can see in from outside that paper door over there!"

units.source_text: 可见此人用心周到，毫不疏忽，其人品甚可敬爱。

en.t: This showed how thoughtful and careful she was, and her character seemed deeply admirable and endearing.

units.source_text: 她的头面和垂发似比前者高超而优雅。

en.t: Her face and falling hair seemed even more refined and elegant than those of the first lady.

units.source_text: 有几个无心无思的青年侍女答道：“那边的纸门外面立着屏风，客人不会马上就窥见的。”

en.t: Several carefree young maids replied, "There is a screen standing outside that paper door, so the guest will not be able to see in right away."

units.source_text: 后来的女公子又说：“如果被他窥见了，真难为情。”

en.t: The young lady who had come later said again, "If he were to see us, it would be truly embarrassing."

units.source_text: 她不放心，又膝行而入，那风度越发高雅了。

en.t: Still uneasy, she went back in on her knees, and her manner appeared all the more graceful.

units.source_text: 她身穿黑色夹衫，颜色与前一人同样，但姿态比前一人更加温柔妩媚，令人不胜怜爱。

en.t: She wore a black lined robe, similar in color to the other lady's, but her bearing was even gentler and more charming, making her irresistibly dear.

units.source_text: 她的头发大约稍有脱落，故末端略疏，颜色是色中最宝贵的翡翠色，一绺绺齐齐整整，非常美丽。

en.t: Her hair had perhaps thinned a little, so the ends were somewhat sparse, but its color was the most precious jade green, and each lock lay neatly and beautifully in place.

units.source_text: 她一手拿着一册写在紫色纸上的经文，手指比前一人纤细，可知身体是瘦削的。

en.t: In one hand she held a scripture written on purple paper; her fingers were more delicate than the first lady's, showing that her body was slender.

units.source_text: 站着的那位女公子也来到门口，不知为了何事，向这边望望，嫣然一笑，非常娇媚。

en.t: The young lady who had been standing also came to the doorway, glanced this way for some unknown reason, and smiled sweetly with extraordinary charm.
